_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Tá tú ag imirt Golf (Cluiche Cárta) - Imreoir {player_id}.
Sprioc: Faigh an scór iomlán is lú sa bhbabhta amháin seo. Má roinntear colúin na gcéanna, déanfar iad a shuimiú mar 0.
Luachanna Cárta: A=1, 2-10=luach aghaidh, J/Q=10, K=0

Gníomhartha (úsáid brácáidí cruinne):
- '[draw]' - Tarraing ón gcruinne
- '[take]' - Tóg ó phíle diúlta
- '[swap X Y]' - Malartaigh cárta tarraingthe le suíomh X (rialtach) Y (colún)
- '[discard]' - Diúltú don chárta tarraingthe

board.drew:
Táirgeadh: {card}
Ní mór duit [swap X Y] nó [discard] a dhéanamh air.
board.took:
Tógtha: {card} as píle diúlta
Ní mór duit [swap X Y] a dhéanamh leis (níl sé in ann diúltú).

options.final_turns: Final turns! Your options: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ní mór duit: [swap X Y] (ní féidir cártaí a dhiúscairt ó charnadh diúscaireachta)
options.swap_or_discard: Ní mór duit: [swap X Y] nó [discard] a dhéanamh

message.deck_empty: Tá an deic folamh! Críochnaíonn an cluiche láithreach.
message.knocked: Imreoir {pid} claonta! Faigheann gach imreoir eile cas amháin níos mó.
message.final_round: Imreoir {pid} {reason}! Faigheann gach imreoir eile ceann amháin eile de thuras.

invalid.wrong_action: Úsáid aon ghníomh brácaithe amháin: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], nó [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Ní mór duit [draw], [take], [knock], nó [peek X Y] a dhéanamh ar dtús
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ní féidir leat cárta a thógtar ón gcarr scartha a dhiúscairt. Caithfidh tú é a mhalartú.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Tá tú cárta tarraingthe. Ní mór duit [swap X Y] nó [discard] é.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Ní mór duit cárta tarraingthe a mhalartú.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Ní mór duit cárta tarraingthe a dhiúscairt.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Suíomh taobh amuigh de theorainneacha. Úsáid rialtach 1-{max_row}, colún 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ní féidir leat a bhualadh le cárta tarraingthe. Críochnú do thuras ar dtús.
invalid.already_knocked: Tá duine éigin buailte cheana féin an babhta seo.
invalid.already_revealed: Tá an cárta sin nochtadh cheana féin!
